description: This file contains unit tests for the OpenClawKit project, specifically testing the CanvasA2UIAction functionalities such as sanitizing tags, extracting action names, and formatting agent messages.

classes.name: CanvasA2UIActionTests
classes.description: A test suite struct containing various unit tests for CanvasA2UIAction functionalities.

methods.name: sanitizeTagValueIsStable

methods.name: extractActionNameAcceptsNameOrAction

methods.name: formatAgentMessageIsTokenEfficientAndUnambiguous
